scope: 65 exact VLOO target cells, 47 unique patients, 20 identical deterministic fixed-query repetitions; FIT+validation only; no outer metrics/predictions/selection
source: fresh exact A1 150-grid audit and exact R4 classifier replay; previous private exact-checkpoint R4 cache may be reused after source, checkpoint, role and B0 verification
split: reuse previous active-fewshot study's stable-hash 50/50 label-blind candidate/query assignments and B=8 availability; no redraw
acquisition: freeze the exact prior 64D residual UNCERTAINTY stepwise acquisition trajectory using its FIT-selected lambda_w and lambda_b=1.0; all B8 deployable readouts receive precisely the same acquired 8 labels and same fixed query per target repetition. FIT episodes use the same legacy acquisition rule with FIT labels only. This policy-fixed design isolates readout estimation from acquisition changes; it does not test each new readout as its own acquisition policy
calibration: all residual teachers use m=m0+b+(Pz) dot a; B0 b=a=0; support-only deterministic analytic-gradient scipy L-BFGS-B maxiter200, zero initialization; A1/R4 frozen; scaler FIT only

stage0.selection: separate B8 and FULL_POOL patient-equal FIT episodic query AP; 3 label-blind episodes per FIT patient per distinct selected checkpoint/threshold; ties within 1e-6 choose larger lambda_w then larger lambda_b
stage0.original_B8: exact prior 64D uncertainty B8 reference, independently recalculated on same support and query
stage0.original_FULL_POOL: exact prior 64D full-pool reference independently recalculated

stage1.PCA: FIT-only PCA over standardized FIT R4 channel rows for each selected checkpoint; no target labels
stage1.selection: FIT-only B8 episodic patient-equal query AP; separate corresponding FULL_POOL lambda selection per dimension

stage2.projection: fold-specific learned linear d-by-64 projection initialized from FIT PCA; d in 4,8,16; same fold FIT patients and selected checkpoint contexts, no target labels
stage2.support: same frozen baseline UNCERTAINTY eight-channel trajectory; no gradient through discrete acquisition
stage2.inner: 64 deterministic unrolled full-batch gradient steps from zero, BCE plus selected FIT lambda_w and lambda_b; per-parameter stable step size 0.5/(2*lambda+FIT-derived curvature bound)
stage2.outer: FIT-query BCE plus 0.1 times FIT-query EZ/NEZ pairwise softplus ranking, at most 128 deterministic FIT-only pairs per episode
stage2.optimizer: AdamW learning rate 0.001, weight_decay 0.0001, batch 32, max_epochs 30, patience 5 on FIT-meta-validation patient-equal query AP, earliest best epoch
stage2.projection_constraint: rows normalized and penalty 0.01 times squared deviation from FIT-PCA initialization
stage2.final_target_head: same selected FIT-only low-dimensional lambda; deterministic L-BFGS-B on acquired support; no target-query training
stage2.dimension_selection: FIT-meta-validation patient-equal query AP only; all three dimensions reported on target

stage3.score: frozen A1 margin plus gamma times [cosine to EZ prototype minus cosine to NEZ prototype]
stage3.one_class_fallback: exact frozen A1 margin, no redraw; report frequency

comparisons: A1; original/retuned 64D B8; PCA d4/d8/d16 B8; MetaProjection d4/d8/d16 B8; prototype B8; original/retuned 64D FULL_POOL; corresponding PCA/Meta FULL_POOL; nondeployable oracle-balanced B8
statistics: paired metrics on identical fixed query; 10,000 patient-ID cluster bootstrap resamples seed42 including all folds/repetitions for sampled IDs; five-fold mean signs; full results not just best
milestone_rule: mean EZ-AP >=0.62/0.65/0.68/0.70, patient-cluster CI lower of AP delta versus current B8 >0, >=4/5 positive folds, MRR and Top1 no material decline; material decline defined as worse than current B8 by >0.005 absolute
improvement_rule: best B8 teacher delta AP vs current B8 >=0.020, patient-cluster CI lower>0, >=4/5 positive folds
fullpool_anomaly_rule: case1 retuned FULL_POOL exceeds retuned B8; case3 retuned B8 exceeds retuned FULL_POOL with patient-cluster CI lower>0; otherwise case2 close. Corresponding low-dimensional comparisons reported descriptively, not used to change terminal
oracle: target-label-using inner-cross-fitted direction for post-score diagnostic only; FIT-standardized coefficient coordinate; never a selection criterion
public_outputs: aggregate code, lock, CSV/JSON, report and aggregate plot only; patient/channel rows, labels, caches, embeddings, checkpoints, logs remain private
legacy_loader: may materialize all 80 labels; disclose strict_no_outer_label_materialization=false if used
